requirement_name: Manufacturer name declared
requirement_description: Every package shall bear the name of the manufacturer (or, where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name of the manufacturer and packer).
applicability_condition: Applies to all retail packages under Chapter II (see LM-R3-001 for Chapter II scope exclusions).
exemption_condition: Packages containing food articles: PFA Act 1954 governs instead per Rule 6(1) Explanation III.
expected_value: Non-empty text identifiable as manufacturer name
notes: If no qualifying words 'manufactured by'/'packed by' appear, Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation I presumes the name/address is the manufacturer's.

requirement_name: Manufacturer address declared
requirement_description: Every package shall bear the complete address of the manufacturer (or manufacturer and packer where different).
applicability_condition: Same as LM-R6-001.
exemption_condition: Food articles: PFA Act 1954 applies instead (Rule 6(1) Explanation III).
expected_value: Non-empty address text
notes: 'Complete address' per Rule 10 Explanation = postal address of factory, or street/premises number + city/State or PIN code sufficient to locate the manufacturer/packer/importer.

requirement_name: Packer name and address declared when manufacturer is not the packer
requirement_description: Where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of both the manufacturer and the packer shall be mentioned.
applicability_condition: Triggered when label text contains 'packed by' distinct from 'manufactured by'.
exemption_condition: Food articles: PFA Act 1954 applies instead.
expected_value: Packer name/address present when 'packed by' wording is detected

requirement_name: Importer name and address declared on imported packages
requirement_description: For any imported package, the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned; where a commodity manufactured outside India is packed in India, the principal display panel must also show the name and complete address of the packer or importer in India.
applicability_condition: Package is an imported package.
expected_value: Importer name/address present on PDP
notes: REVIEW_REQUIRED: the base 2011 Rules text provided does not contain an explicit stand-alone 'country of origin' declaration requirement; no separate amendment document establishing such a requirement was supplied, so no country_of_origin row is included here to avoid inventing a rule.

requirement_name: Common or generic name of commodity declared
requirement_description: The common or generic name of the commodity in the package shall be mentioned; for multi-product packages, the name and number/quantity of each product shall be mentioned.
expected_value: Non-empty generic commodity name text

requirement_name: Net quantity declared
requirement_description: The net quantity of the commodity, in terms of the standard unit of weight/measure, or the number of commodity units, shall be mentioned on the package.
expected_value: Numeric value with a valid unit (see Rule 12/13)
unit_or_format: g, kg, ml, l, cm, m, sq. m, or count (N/U) per Rule 12(2)/13

requirement_name: Month and year of manufacture/pre-packing/import declared
requirement_description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned on the package, expressed in words, numerals, or both.
exemption_condition: Not required on: (i) bidi/incense-stick packages; (ii) domestic LPG cylinders of 14.2kg/5kg bottled/marketed by a public sector undertaking (Rule 6(1)(g) proviso A). Not required for food packages where 'best before/use before' is 90 days or less from manufacture (Rule 6(1)(g) proviso B second proviso). Not required for certified Seeds Act packages. Food articles generally follow PFA Act 1954 instead.
expected_value: Month/Year in a recognizable date format
notes: A rubber-stamp-without-overwriting proviso to Rule 6(1)(d) stood withdrawn wef 2012-07-01 vide GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011 -- not applicable as of the current date.

requirement_name: Retail sale price (MRP) declared
requirement_description: The retail sale price of the package shall be declared in the form 'Maximum or Max. retail price Rs/... inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP Rs/... incl. of all taxes', with paisa rounding rules applied.
exemption_condition: Not required on bidi packages, or domestic LPG cylinders priced under the Government's Administrative Price Mechanism (Rule 6(1)(g) proviso C). Alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor: State Excise laws apply unless those laws are silent on MRP declaration, in which case these Rules apply.
expected_value: Rupee amount preceded by 'MRP' or 'Maximum/Max. retail price', with an 'inclusive of all taxes' qualifier
unit_or_format: MRP Rs.<amount> incl. of all taxes

requirement_name: Dimensions of commodity declared where size is relevant
requirement_description: Where the sizes of the commodity in the package are relevant, its dimensions (and dimensions of each differing piece, if applicable) shall be declared.
applicability_condition: Applies only to commodities for which size/dimension is relevant to the transaction (e.g. bed-sheets, fabrics per Rule 14; also Rule 15, Rule 16, Rule 17 container-type goods).
expected_value: Dimension text with unit
unit_or_format: cm/m or per Rule 13 unit rules
notes: Requires product-category-specific logic to determine applicability (bedsheets/fabrics/sheets/containers); REVIEW_REQUIRED for automatic applicability detection.

requirement_name: Consumer-care details declared
requirement_description: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address (if available) of the person/office that can be contacted for consumer complaints.
expected_value: Contact name/address and a valid phone number; email if declared
unit_or_format: Free text; phone number regex; email regex
notes: E-mail address is only mandatory 'if available' -- absence of email alone should not be scored as a violation; REVIEW_REQUIRED on how to interpret 'if available' automatically.

requirement_name: No individual stickers used to alter/make required declarations
requirement_description: It is not permissible to affix individual stickers on a package to alter or make a declaration required under these rules, except a sticker reducing the MRP (which must not cover the original manufacturer/packer MRP declaration).
exemption_condition: MRP-reduction stickers are permitted if they do not cover the original MRP declaration (Rule 6(3) proviso).
notes: Detecting a sticker vs. printed label, and distinguishing a permitted MRP-reduction sticker from a prohibited one, is not reliably automatable from a single package photo; must remain MANUAL_REVIEW.

requirement_name: Minimum numeral height for net quantity in weight/volume
requirement_description: The height of numerals in the declaration on the principal display panel shall meet minimum heights per Table-I when net quantity is declared by weight or volume: up to 200g/ml -> 1mm (2mm if blown/molded/embossed/perforated); above 200 up to 500g/ml -> 2mm (4mm); above 500g/ml -> 4mm (6mm).
applicability_condition: Net quantity declared by weight or volume.
exemption_condition: Sub-rules (1)-(3) do not apply if the same information is already required to be given under any other law in force (Rule 7(4)).
expected_value: 1mm / 2mm / 4mm minimum (2mm/4mm/6mm if blown, formed, molded, embossed or perforated) depending on declared net quantity band
unit_or_format: millimetres, measured via calibrated pixel-to-mm scale
notes: Requires a physical reference marker (e.g. ArUco) in the photo to convert pixel height to millimetres; net-quantity band must first be extracted (LM-R6-006) to select the correct threshold.

requirement_name: Minimum numeral height for net quantity in length/area/number
requirement_description: Minimum numeral height per Table-II when net quantity is declared by length, area or number, banded by principal-display-panel area: up to 100 cm2 -> 1mm (2mm blown/molded); above 100 to 500 cm2 and above 500 to 2500 cm2 -> intermediate bands; above 2500 cm2 -> 6mm.
applicability_condition: Net quantity declared by length, area or number.
exemption_condition: Rule 7(4) other-law exemption.
expected_value: Per Table-II bands (see requirement_description)
notes: Table-II as supplied has an ambiguous/garbled row for the '2/4' band boundary; REVIEW_REQUIRED to confirm exact intermediate values against an authoritative copy before implementation.

requirement_name: Minimum letter height and width-to-height ratio
requirement_description: Height of letters in any declaration shall not be less than 1mm (2mm if blown/formed/molded/embossed/perforated); letter/numeral width shall not be less than one-third of its height, except for numeral '1' and letters i/I/l.
expected_value: >=1mm height (>=2mm if blown/molded); width >= height/3 (except '1','i','I','l')

requirement_name: Card/tape PDP permitted for very small packages
requirement_description: For packages with capacity of 5 cubic centimetres or less, the principal display panel may be a card or tape firmly affixed to the package, bearing the required information.
applicability_condition: Package capacity <= 5 cubic cm.
notes: Package volume cannot reliably be determined from a 2D photograph without additional calibration; treat as MANUAL_REVIEW.

requirement_name: Declarations must appear on the principal display panel
requirement_description: Every declaration required under these rules shall appear on the principal display panel of the package.
expected_value: All required declaration fields located within the identified PDP region
notes: Requires PDP region detection (object/label segmentation) before placement can be verified; not planned for the initial prototype.

requirement_name: Clear space surrounding the quantity declaration
requirement_description: The area surrounding the net quantity declaration must be free of printed information: above and below by a space at least equal to the numeral height, and left and right by a space at least twice the numeral height.
expected_value: Clear margin >= numeral height (top/bottom) and >= 2x numeral height (left/right)

requirement_name: Returnable soft-drink bottle MRP placement exemption
requirement_description: For returnable soft drink/ready-to-serve fruit beverage bottles, the retail sale price may appear on the crown cap and/or the bottle, and 'MRP Rs....' form suffices.
applicability_condition: Returnable, refillable soft-drink/beverage bottles.

requirement_name: Declaration legible and prominent
requirement_description: Every declaration required under these rules shall be legible and prominent.
expected_value: OCR confidence above an implementation-defined legibility threshold

requirement_name: MRP and net-quantity numerals in contrasting colour
requirement_description: Numerals of the retail sale price and net-quantity declaration shall be printed/painted/inscribed in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the label background.
exemption_condition: Not required where the information is blown, formed or molded on a glass/plastic surface (Rule 9(1) proviso a).
expected_value: Measured contrast ratio above an implementation-defined threshold

requirement_name: Handwritten declarations must be clear and unambiguous
requirement_description: Where a declaration is hand-written or hand-scripted, it shall be clear, unambiguous and legible.
applicability_condition: Declaration is hand-written/hand-scripted rather than printed.
notes: Handwriting-quality judgement is subjective; flag for MANUAL_REVIEW rather than automated pass/fail.

requirement_name: Declaration must not require reading through liquid contents
requirement_description: No declaration shall be made so as to require it to be read through any liquid commodity contained in the package.
applicability_condition: Liquid-content packages.

requirement_name: Outer wrapper/container must carry required declarations
requirement_description: Where a package has an outside container or wrapper, that container/wrapper must also bear all required declarations, unless it is transparent and the inner declarations are easily readable through it.
applicability_condition: Package has a secondary outer container/wrapper.
exemption_condition: Transparent wrapper through which inner declarations are easily readable; also not required if the inner package itself carries no declaration on its outer cover.

requirement_name: Declarations in Hindi (Devanagari) or English
requirement_description: Declaration particulars shall be in Hindi (Devanagari script) or English; other languages may be used in addition.
expected_value: At least one declaration set in Hindi (Devanagari) or English

requirement_name: Manufacturer/packer/importer name and address conspicuous
requirement_description: Every package kept, offered, exposed for sale or sold shall conspicuously bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer (or manufacturer and packer, or importer for imported packages).
exemption_condition: Packages of capacity 5 cubic cm or less: a mark/inscription enabling identification of the manufacturer/packer/importer suffices (Rule 10(1) first proviso).
notes: Overlaps with LM-R6-001/002; this row adds the 'conspicuous' visual-prominence check on top of mere text presence.

requirement_name: Complete address includes PIN code or locatable identifiers
requirement_description: 'Complete address' means the postal address of the factory, or the street/premises number and city/State (or PIN code) sufficient for a consumer to identify and locate the manufacturer, packer or importer.
expected_value: Address text containing a 6-digit Indian PIN code, or city+State

requirement_name: Name must be actual corporate/trading name
requirement_description: The name of the manufacturer, packer or importer shall be the actual corporate name, or, if not incorporated, the name under which the business is conducted in India.
notes: Verifying corporate-name validity requires an external company/registration database; out of scope for an image-only prototype.

requirement_name: Quantity declared in the correct measurement dimension for the commodity type
requirement_description: Except for Fourth Schedule commodities, quantity shall be declared by mass (solid/semi-solid/viscous/mixture), length (linear-sold), area (area-sold), volume (liquid/cubic-sold), or number (number-sold), matching the commodity's nature.
applicability_condition: Commodity not listed in the Fourth Schedule (see LM-R12-EXC for Fourth Schedule exceptions).
exemption_condition: Fourth Schedule commodities may use the dimension specified in that Schedule instead (e.g., aerosol products by weight, fruits by number or weight).
expected_value: Declared unit matches expected physical dimension for the recognized commodity category
notes: Requires a commodity-category-to-expected-dimension lookup table, including all Fourth Schedule exceptions; not implemented in the initial prototype.

requirement_name: No misleading/exaggerating quantity wording
requirement_description: The quantity declaration shall not contain words/expressions creating an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression of quantity, e.g. 'minimum', 'not less than', 'average', 'about', 'approximately' or similar.
expected_value: Absence of prohibited qualifying words/phrases adjacent to the net-quantity declaration
notes: Original wording (effective 2011-04-01 to 2012-06-30) listed the specific example words above. It was replaced wef 2012-07-01 (GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011) with a broader prohibition on 'any word or expression of any sort, whatsoever' creating or likely to create such an impression. The broader post-2012 wording is currently applicable; exact wording is inherently subjective for automated matching beyond a keyword list, so results should be treated as indicative, not exhaustive.

requirement_name: Correct sub-unit/multiple used per declared quantity magnitude
requirement_description: Quantities below 1kg/1m/1sq.m/1 cubic decimetre/1 litre must use gram/centimetre/square decimetre/cubic centimetre/millilitre respectively; quantities at or above those thresholds must use the base unit (kg/m/sq.m/cubic m/litre) with decimal fractions.
exemption_condition: Exact 1kg/1m/1sq.m/1 cubic decimetre/1 cubic metre/1 litre quantities may optionally use the smaller unit (Rule 13(3) proviso).
expected_value: Unit consistent with the magnitude thresholds in Rule 13(2)/(3)
unit_or_format: g/kg, cm/m, ml/l, cubic cm/cubic m, sq. decimetre/sq. m

requirement_name: Prohibited counting terms not used
requirement_description: No number called dozen, score, gross, great gross or the like shall be specified or indicated on any package.
applicability_condition: Quantity declared by number.
expected_value: Absence of 'dozen'/'score'/'gross'/'great gross' near quantity declaration

requirement_name: SI units only; number-sold items use symbol N or U
requirement_description: No system of units other than the International System of Units (SI) shall be used to express net quantity; items sold by number shall use the symbol N or U.
expected_value: SI unit symbol (g/kg/ml/l/cm/m etc.), or N/U for number-sold items

requirement_name: Wholesale package: manufacturer/importer/packer name and address
requirement_description: Every wholesale package shall bear the name and address of the manufacturer or importer, or, where the manufacturer/importer is not the packer, of the packer.
applicability_condition: Package meets the Rule 2(r) definition of a wholesale package.
exemption_condition: Not applicable if an equivalent declaration is already required under another law in force (Rule 24 proviso).

requirement_name: Wholesale package: identity of commodity
requirement_description: Every wholesale package shall bear the identity of the commodity contained in the package.
exemption_condition: Rule 24 proviso (other-law equivalent declaration).

requirement_name: Wholesale package: count of retail packages or net quantity
requirement_description: Every wholesale package shall bear the total number of retail packages contained in it, or the net quantity in standard units of the commodity contained.
exemption_condition: Rule 24 proviso (other-law equivalent declaration).

requirement_name: Exemption for very small net-weight/volume packages
requirement_description: These rules do not apply to a package if the net weight/measure of the commodity is 10g or 10ml or less (sold by weight/measure). This exemption does NOT apply to (i) tobacco and tobacco products, and (ii) pan masala.
applicability_condition: Declared net quantity <= 10g or <= 10ml, AND commodity is not tobacco/tobacco products and not pan masala.
exemption_condition: Full exemption for packages <=10g/10ml, EXCEPT tobacco and tobacco products (carve-out proviso in force since 2015-05-14 per G.S.R. 385(E)) and EXCEPT pan masala (carve-out proviso in force since 2026-02-01 per G.S.R. 881(E) dated 2025-12-02).
expected_value: If net_quantity <= 10g/10ml AND commodity is not tobacco/tobacco-product/pan masala, other declaration rules are not applicable; if commodity IS tobacco/tobacco product or pan masala, the small-pack exemption does NOT apply regardless of quantity and full declarations are required.
legal_source: Rule 26(a), as amended (base clause; first proviso; second proviso)
source_document: Exemption from LM Rules for Small Packs Not Applicable to Pan Masala.md
notes: AMENDMENT HISTORY for Rule 26(a): (1) Base exemption in force since 2011-04-01. (2) A proviso requiring MRP and net-quantity declarations on packages of 10-20g/10-20ml stood withdrawn wef 2012-07-01 vide GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011 (per the base 2011 Rules document; no longer relevant to current wording). (3) First proviso excluding tobacco and tobacco products from this exemption was inserted vide G.S.R. 385(E) dated 14.05.2015 -- this GSR notification itself was not separately uploaded; its text is known only via citation/quotation inside the uploaded 'Exemption from LM Rules for Small Packs Not Applicable to Pan Masala.md' document, which is treated here as the traceable source for that citation. (4) Second proviso excluding pan masala was inserted by the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Second (Amendment) Rules, 2025 vide G.S.R. 881(E) dated 02.12.2025, commencing 2026-02-01 -- this document was directly uploaded and is the source_document for the currently applicable wording. STATUS as of 2026-08-29: currently effective (not future-dated, not superseded, not deleted). This row was flagged and corrected during the 2026-08-29 amendment-verification pass; the previously generated version of this row did not reflect the tobacco (2015) or pan masala (2026) carve-outs.

requirement_name: Exemption for restaurant/hotel fast-food packages
requirement_description: These rules do not apply to any package containing fast-food items packed by a restaurant, hotel or the like.
applicability_condition: Fast-food item packed by a restaurant/hotel.
exemption_condition: Full exemption.
notes: Requires classifying the package as restaurant/hotel fast food, which is not reliably determinable from label text alone.

requirement_name: Exemption for certain drug formulations
requirement_description: These rules do not apply to packages containing scheduled and non-scheduled formulations covered under the Drugs (Price Control) Order, 1995 made under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955.
applicability_condition: Commodity is a scheduled/non-scheduled drug formulation under DPCO 1995.
exemption_condition: Full exemption.
notes: Requires legal/domain classification against DPCO 1995 schedules; out of prototype scope.

requirement_name: Exemption for large agricultural produce packages
requirement_description: These rules do not apply to agricultural farm produce in packages above 50kg.
applicability_condition: Agricultural produce; declared/actual net quantity > 50kg.
exemption_condition: Full exemption.

requirement_name: Chapter II (retail declarations) scope exclusions
requirement_description: Chapter II does not apply to: (a) packages of commodities over 25kg or 25 litre, excluding cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50kg; and (b) packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers.
applicability_condition: Determines whether the retail-package declaration rules (Rules 4-18) apply at all to a given package.
exemption_condition: Cement/fertilizer bags up to 50kg remain within Chapter II despite exceeding 25kg. Industrial/institutional-consumer packages are excluded regardless of size.
expected_value: Declared net quantity <= 25kg/25L (or <=50kg for cement/fertilizer) and not marked for industrial/institutional use
notes: Industrial/institutional-consumer status is generally not determinable from the package image alone; treat as MANUAL_REVIEW when quantity is borderline or industrial/institutional markings are detected.

requirement_name: Standard package quantity for Second-Schedule commodities
requirement_description: Commodities listed in the Second Schedule (e.g. baby food, biscuits, bread, edible oils, tea, salt, soaps, aerated drinks, cement, paints, etc.) must be packed in the standard quantities specified for that commodity in the Second Schedule.
applicability_condition: Commodity matches a Second Schedule category.
expected_value: Declared net quantity matches one of the Second Schedule's permitted standard sizes for that commodity
notes: A historical proviso (2011-04-01 to 2012-06-30, withdrawn vide GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011) required a 'Not a standard pack size ...' label when a non-standard size was used; that proviso is no longer in force. Requires a commodity-category classifier plus a full Second Schedule lookup table; out of scope for the initial prototype.

requirement_name: Ice cream and similar frozen products quantity dimension
requirement_description: Ice cream and other similar frozen products are a Fourth Schedule exception to the general dimension rule in Rule 12(2).
applicability_condition: Commodity category = ice cream or similar frozen product.
expected_value: Weight (currently applicable, effective 2012-07-01)
notes: Item 15 originally specified 'Volume' (effective 2011-04-01 to 2012-06-30); amended to 'Weight' wef 2012-07-01 vide GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011. The Weight requirement is currently applicable.

requirement_name: E-commerce country-of-origin filter for imported product listings
requirement_description: Every e-commerce entity selling imported products shall provide the product listings of such imported products in a searchable and sortable filter specifying the country of origin.
applicability_condition: Applies to e-commerce entities that sell imported products; this is a listing/website-level obligation on the e-commerce entity, not a declaration printed on the physical package.
expected_value: Country-of-origin filter present and functional (searchable and sortable) on the e-commerce listing for each imported product.
source_document: MINISTRY OF CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION.md
notes: Inserted by the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2026, vide G.S.R. 128(E) dated 13.02.2026, commencing 2026-07-01.
